{{Top|leg}}
'''Jarael-One''' was the override command phrase that [[Gorman Vandrayk|Camper]] used to disable the [[HK-24 series assassin droid|HK-24]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] that were guarding him while he completed the [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorth]] project for [[Arkoh Adasca]].
